title: Spectral Algorithms for 3-Wave Kinetic and $C_{12}$ Quantum Boltzmann Equations with General Resonance Manifolds in $\mathbb{R}^d$
summary: Following recent developments in numerical schemes for 3-wave kinetic equations [2, 7, 42, 44, 43], we develop spectral algorithms for multidimensional 3-wave kinetic equations and $C_{12}$ quantum Boltzmann equations with general polynomial dispersion relations. The principal numerical difficulty arises from the resonance constraint, supported on a nonlinear manifold in wave-vector space.
